base: Simple flat medical illustration for a home rehabilitation sheet. An older Japanese adult (gender-neutral, short gray hair) in a plain light-gray T-shirt and navy pants. Clean black outlines, flat colors, one light-blue movement arrow, white background, no text, no shadows, only necessary props. Square, full body centered with margin.
method: Built-in image_gen. ex01/ex06/ex14 prototypes, remaining images use ex01 as the character and style reference. Outputs resampled to 1024x1024 PNG; 256x256 thumbnails for display.
